description: This plot illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for different models. The x-axis is labeled “Temperature” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8)” and has a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. A solid orange line with triangle markers represents “On-policy RL”, starting at approximately 76.5 at a temperature of 0.1 and ending at approximately 71.0 at a temperature of 1.0, with a low point of approximately 68.0 at a temperature of 0.8. A solid red line with star markers represents a second model, starting at approximately 76.5 at a temperature of 0.1 and ending at approximately 80.0 at a temperature of 1.0, with a peak of approximately 80.5 at a temperature of 0.8. A solid blue line with downward-pointing triangle markers represents “SFT”, starting at approximately 75.0 at a temperature of 0.1 and ending at approximately 74.0 at a temperature of 1.0, with a low point of approximately 70.0 at a temperature of 0.6.
